== Description ==

Six Players Committee Community Award cards laid out on a table at the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025: ''Hayes H'' ([[Hayes Hunter]], 2024 Hall of Fame), ''James M'' (Solidsnck, 2022 Advocate Award), ''Mark W'' (Fig_1 / [[Mark Walseth]], 2017 Hall of Fame), ''David W'' (noreply, 2023 Advocate Award), ''Sean L'' (Luhks, 2024 Advocate Award), and ''Sam T'' (Yoshi / [[Sam Tashima]], 2022 Advocate Award).
